Name: Stardew Discord Notifier
Author: TamKungZ
Description:
[size=5][b]Stardew Discord Notifier[/b][/size]
[line]
Stay connected with your farm's progress directly in your Discord server! This mod sends a webhook notification every morning when a new day starts in Stardew Valley.
It is perfect for multiplayer servers to notify friends when the day has passed, or for players who want a log of their daily progress.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] [b]Real-time Notifications:[/b] Sends a message immediately when the player wakes up.
[*] [b]Customizable Info:[/b] Choose exactly what you want to see via Config.
[*] [b]Weather & Luck:[/b] Displays daily weather (with emojis!) and daily luck status.
[*] [b]Events:[/b] Notifies you of NPC Birthdays and Festivals happening that day.
[*] [b]Money Tracker:[/b] Shows your current gold.
[*] [b]Configuration:[/b] Customize the Bot Name, Avatar, and Message Header.
[/list]
[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
You can configure the mod using [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] directly in-game, or by editing the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file.
[b]Options include:[/b]
[list]
[*] Enable/Disable specific information (Date, Money, Weather, Luck, Birthday, Festival, [b]Online Players[/b]).
[*] Toggle "Show None" if there is no birthday/festival (or hide the line completely).
[*] Change the Webhook URL, Bot Username, and Avatar URL.
[*] [b]Embed Mode:[/b] Switch between plain text or a stylish Discord Embed message.
[/list]
[size=4][b]How to Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
[*] (Optional but Recommended) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy configuration.
[*] Download this mod and unzip it into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.
[*] Run the game once to generate the config file.
[/list]
[size=4][b]How to Setup Discord Webhook[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*] Go to your Discord Server settings -> Integrations -> Webhooks.
[*] Create a new Webhook and copy the [b]Webhook URL[/b].
[*] Paste the URL into the [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] settings in-game OR into the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file.
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/40940/40940-1767743709-710160333.png[/img]﻿
[size=4][b]
Localization[/b][/size]
This mod supports [b]i18n[/b]. It currently includes:
[list]
[*] English (Default)
[*] Thai (ภาษาไทย)
[/list]
Feel free to contribute translations!
